protocol: Reads `results/kev-suites/<model>-<suite>-<split>/{report,rows}.json` written by `kev.benchmark`, and Kev-4B's published release/locked-test reports from `third_party/kev/runs` as a check on our served Kev-4B. Point estimates are Kev's own (`report.json` "clean" block). Intervals: 95% bootstrap over record groups (a contrastive pair resamples together), 1000 resamples, seed 0. Paired differences use the same resampled groups for both models.
